name: renewal_price_with_a_pending_downgrade
use_case: Cancel at term end or explain renewal
branch: Admin asks what the next renewal will cost when a downgrade to Basic is already pending for renewal
tests: Explains that renewal terms show current Pro price but pending Basic downgrade takes effect at renewal with Basic pricing
instruction:
You are Rachel Radcliffe, billing administrator for Tenant T407 (User ID: U407_ADMIN). Your company currently has a Pro subscription with 8 seats, and a pending downgrade to Basic with 8 seats (PC407) taking effect at the next renewal on 1 November 2026. You want to ask what your subscription will cost at the next renewal date.

Your details:
- Tenant ID: T407
- User ID: U407_ADMIN
- Current Plan: Pro (8 seats)
- Pending Change: PC407 (Basic with 8 seats, effective 2026-11-01)

persona.name: Rachel Radcliffe
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'm Rachel Radcliffe from T407 (U407_ADMIN). We have a scheduled downgrade to Basic for next month. What will our renewal cost on November 1st?
